title: 3D Coverflow Touch Slider (Swiper.js Alternative)
description: An impressive 3D coverflow touch slider, built in plain JavaScript with no Swiper.js library. Swiping left/right on mobile spins the cards in 3D. Best suited for: Product Galleries, App Screenshots, Testimonials, and Category Selectors. Ultra Max Premium Pro Super Features and Ultra Max Premium Pro Super Animation, Graphic Effects.
